title: Attendance and Discipline Thresholds for Transfer and Choice Placements
content:
For each enrollment type of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, the district sets the attendance and discipline levels at which a transfer or choice placement may be revoked, the point at which a revocation takes effect and the minimum notice the campus gives in writing.

| Enrollment type | Unexcused absences in one semester at which the placement may be revoked | Tardies in one semester at which the placement may be revoked | Placement in a disciplinary alternative education program allows revocation | When a revocation takes effect | Minimum calendar days between the written revocation notice and the effective date |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Attendance Zone Enrollment | 0 (not revocable for attendance) | 0 (not revocable for tardies) | no | not applicable | 0 |
| Intra-District Transfer (Space Available) | 10 | 15 | yes | end of the current semester | 10 |
| Intra-District Transfer (Employee Child) | 10 | 15 | yes | end of the current semester | 10 |
| Non-Resident Transfer | 10 | 15 | yes | end of the current semester | 10 |
| Choice Program Enrollment | 10 | 0 (not revocable for tardies) | yes | end of the current semester | 10 |
| Pre-Kindergarten (State-Eligible) | 0 (not revocable for attendance) | 0 (not revocable for tardies) | no | not applicable | 0 |
| Pre-Kindergarten (Tuition-Based) | 0 (not revocable for attendance) | 0 (not revocable for tardies) | no | not applicable | 0 |

A threshold of 0 means the placement of that type is not revocable on that ground.

## Points of judgement

- Counts are taken within one semester. A Non-Resident Transfer student who reaches 10 unexcused absences in one semester has reached the absence threshold; a student with 9 has not.
- Tardies do not reach any threshold on Choice Program Enrollment, whose tardy threshold is 0, however many there are; 15 tardies in one semester reach the threshold on each of the three transfer types.
